summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Fidelis Insurance Holdings Ltd (a Bermuda-domiciled foreign private issuer) reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 28, 2026. Shareholders voted on four standard proposals: election of three Class III directors, ratification of KPMG Audit Limited as independent auditor, approval to change the company name to Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited (effective May 11, 2026, with ticker symbol PLGO), and approval of amended and restated bye-laws. All proposals passed with substantial majorities. No special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns are disclosed. The filing is purely an ordinary governance update with no M&A or structural transaction.
